instruction: An orca frozen mid-breach, described only by glowing tube-like edges tracing its ribs, fluke and tall dorsal fin. Electric cyan wires define the body contours while magenta accents outline the eye patch and belly saddle, all floating over a dark void. Faint bloom haloes each strand and the interior remains completely open and hollow.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Neon Wireframe Orca in a neon-wireframe style. An orca frozen mid-breach, described only by glowing tube-like edges tracing its ribs, fluke and tall dorsal fin. Electric cyan wires define the body contours while magenta accents outline the eye patch and belly saddle, all floating over a dark void. Faint bloom haloes each strand and the interior remains completely open and hollow. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
